rules: A legacy Kanban card never creates, upgrades, or substitutes a typed prerequisite receipt.
A legacy done card may be historically corroborated by typed receipts, but progress is computed only from those receipts.
Historical T1, T2 and T2-R2 cards are explicitly quarantined from cognition authority.
No silent grandfathering from workflow completion into Worth-Making, Executive review, Blueprint, compile/hash or Founder authorization is permitted.
